actual.titulo: Death by Fame • Day in Court
actual.descripcion: Day in Court | A sheriff's deputy turned actor reaches new heights of fame as a bailiff on an Emmy-winning show. When a shooting at his house leaves him injured and his wife dead, police learn there's more to this court TV star.

siguiente.descripcion: Legal Diva | A bodybuilding attorney lands her own reality series featuring her former fashion model boyfriend; a year later, investigators use her show to map how this legal diva went from the spotlight to becoming a stabbing victim.

lista.descripcion: Enter the Ghost World | YouTuber Randy Stair wants to be the master of his universe, but he struggles to make friends in real life; when the lines begin to blur between his supermarket day job and his online fantasies, he looks for control wherever he can find it.

lista.descripcion: Devil in Disguise | April shines positivity, growing her TikTok through wholesome family content and manifesting a better future. Things are not always what they seem. After a tragic incident, April's mom gets on TikTok and uncovers secrets that shock everyone watching.

lista.titulo: Blood Relatives • Wasted Away
lista.descripcion: Wasted Away | In Logan, Ohio, investigators receive word someone has been kidnapped from their job at the bank in a car that resembles a police cruiser; eventually, detectives discover a very personal connection between the victim and the kidnappers.

lista.titulo: Blood Relatives • A Killing in Rotation
lista.descripcion: A Killing in Rotation | In Pueblo, Colo., police are called to a horrific scene where a fire reveals the charred remains of a body; as detectives work to track down the killer, their investigation uncovers cracks in the foundation of a large, multi-generational family.

lista.titulo: My Family's Deadly Secret • Murder at the House of God
lista.descripcion: Murder at the House of God | In January 2014, Nathan and Krystal Maddox are gunned down just seconds after leaving a remote church in Texas; the brutal double murder leaves a close-knit community traumatized.
